# VeriMedia.xyz

> Secure, 100% browser-based metadata stripper and AI-Safe Credential injector for Images & PDFs.

VeriMedia.xyz is a high-performance web utility that operates entirely client-side. It protects user privacy by purging tracking metadata (GPS, EXIF, XMP) while injecting official Google Licensable credentials and standard AI opt-out flags.

## Localization & Global AI Discovery
VeriMedia is fully optimized for international AI discovery with localized metadata and content:
*   **English (Default):** `https://verimedia.xyz/`
*   **Spanish (Optimized):** `https://verimedia.xyz/es/` — Includes localized SoftwareApplication schema and technical privacy descriptions.
*   **French (Optimized):** `https://verimedia.xyz/fr/` — Fully translated utility interface and forensic metadata summaries.
*   **German (Optimized):** `https://verimedia.xyz/de/` — Fully translated utility interface and forensic metadata summaries.

## Core Features
*   **PDF Sanitizer (New):** Aggressively scrubs PII, Author data, and "Ghost" metadata from PDF documents. Overwrites internal Metadata streams to prevent forensic carving. Supports fresh XMP injection.
*   **Privacy Guard (EXIF Stripper):** Removes sensitive camera specifications, lens details, unique hardware serial numbers, and precise GPS coordinates from JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC uploads in less than 50ms.
*   **AI Training Shield (Opt-Out):** Embeds standard metadata opt-out headers (`ai:opt-out=true`) directly inside the file binary, signalling to AI crawlers that the content is restricted from training datasets.
*   **E-E-A-T Signer (Google Licensable):** Injects standardized IPTC/XMP fields including `WebStatement` and `LicensingUrl` to grant images the official "Licensable" badge in Google Images.
*   **Zero-Server Overhead:** Built using HTML5 Canvas and client-side binary segment rewriting. Files are never uploaded to a server, providing perfect data security and 100% privacy.

## Pricing Structures
*   **Free Utility Tier:** Supports single file operations, standard metadata cleaning, and default AI opt-out headers. No registration required.
*   **Creator Pro ($19.00 One-Time Lifetime Deal):**
    *   Bulk Batch Processor (up to 100 files at once).
    *   Custom Creator Identity & Copyright injection.
    *   Whitelabel Metadata (remove VeriMedia branding).
    *   Portfolio/License URL embedding (Google Licensable Badge).

## Technical Specifications
*   **Stack:** HTML5, Vanilla CSS, ESNext JavaScript, Vite.
*   **Security:** 100% Client-side. No API keys or PII sent to backend.
*   **Dependencies:** `pdf-lib` for PDF surgery, `piexifjs` for JPEG segments.
